notes: Shared learning: your estimates now also learn from the real grades other Cardwright users share, not just your own. It starts once enough people have shared, and you can turn it off in Settings
Full arts on a black background: cards with a dark border are found properly, and the scanner's light on the cut edge no longer counts as whitening
Fixes: no false sharpening warning on silver-edged full arts, and the same scan file isn't listed twice
